required_data: VNAT/GSO/local DoT arrivals; immigration/transport aggregates
why_not_fake: Counts come from official or operator aggregates, not dashboard guesses
operational_decision: Staffing, capacity planning, campaign calendar
threshold_localization: Different thresholds for gateway cities, islands, mountain routes and day-trip destinations

required_data: OTA partner booking/search/availability; hotel PMS/channel manager
why_not_fake: Uses observed market actions and availability movements
operational_decision: Early warning before peak dates; hotel/transport readiness
threshold_localization: Island and beach destinations should trigger earlier due to limited capacity

formula: normalized search interest by destination keyword and origin
required_data: Google Trends/approved search trend providers
why_not_fake: Search index is an observed intent signal, not visitor count
operational_decision: Detect demand surges before bookings or arrivals appear
threshold_localization: Use local language aliases and origin-market thresholds

required_data: Booking, trends, flight, events
why_not_fake: Composite only from audited components with coverage flags
operational_decision: Activate surge playbook and communications
threshold_localization: Weights vary by fly-in island versus drive-in weekend markets

required_data: Traffic APIs, sensors, parking, transport operators
why_not_fake: Measures physical pressure with observed movement and capacity data
operational_decision: Rerouting, police/traffic control, shuttle frequency
threshold_localization: Urban corridors tolerate lower delay than remote mountain/island access routes

required_data: Camera/telco aggregates, beach polygons, lifeguard counts
why_not_fake: Requires measured or audited estimated counts and GIS area
operational_decision: Beach closure, time-slot guidance, alternative beaches
threshold_localization: Capacity differs by beach width, tide, lifeguard coverage and safety risk

formula: median wait minutes at POI/service point
required_data: ticket gates, operator logs, mobile app check-ins, manual counters
why_not_fake: Direct waiting-time observation, not a proxy-only metric
operational_decision: Open more gates, redirect visitors, adjust time slots
threshold_localization: Heritage sites and ferry terminals require stricter thresholds

formula: weighted congestion, density, queue and complaint score by POI
required_data: POI sensors, reviews/social complaints, traffic
why_not_fake: POI-specific measured pressure
operational_decision: Trigger micro-rerouting and staffing
threshold_localization: Thresholds by POI capacity, cultural sensitivity and safety

required_data: Mobility/booking uptake, campaign clicks, attraction entry counts, post-visit sentiment
why_not_fake: Measures actual uptake after intervention
operational_decision: Stop, continue or revise rerouting campaign
threshold_localization: Same-day thresholds only for low-friction alternatives

required_data: Mobility aggregates, tickets, hotel bookings, OTA packages
why_not_fake: Causal baseline comparison prevents vanity counts
operational_decision: Assess whether alternatives receive demand
threshold_localization: Use season, day-of-week and event baselines

formula: 1 - normalized variance of load/capacity across connected destinations
required_data: Crowd, hotel, transport and POI capacity across graph
why_not_fake: Compares load against capacity, not raw visitor equality
operational_decision: Balance network pressure without harming revenue
threshold_localization: Mountain/island destinations should not be forced to equal urban load

required_data: GSO/local revenue, tax aggregates, hotel/restaurant revenue proxies
why_not_fake: Economic metric from revenue time series
operational_decision: Off-season strategy, campaign targeting
threshold_localization: Seasonal destinations accept more variance but should improve year over year

required_data: Hotel PMS/STR/AirDNA/OTA partner availability
why_not_fake: True occupancy needs partner/operator data; OTA listing count is only proxy
operational_decision: Hotel staffing, price, destination capacity
threshold_localization: Target band differs for city hotels, resorts, homestays and islands

required_data: survey, card/payment aggregates, tax, business reports
why_not_fake: Uses spend numerator and visitor denominator
operational_decision: Prioritize high-value low-pressure segments
threshold_localization: Local purchasing power and destination type affect benchmarks

required_data: hotel PMS, official accommodation stats, surveys
why_not_fake: Measures overnight economic depth
operational_decision: Promote multi-day routes and bundles
threshold_localization: Day-trip corridors and islands have different targets

required_data: GSO/local revenue, hotel revenue, payment/tax aggregates
why_not_fake: Baseline-based, not total annual revenue
operational_decision: Evaluate festivals, discounts, route campaigns
threshold_localization: Off-season months differ by region and climate

formula: weighted load/capacity for traffic, waste, water, electricity, emergency services
required_data: utilities, environment, transport, emergency service logs
why_not_fake: Built from physical infrastructure loads
operational_decision: Điều phối dịch vụ công và kiểm soát quảng bá khi hạ tầng căng
threshold_localization: Small islands and heritage towns need lower thresholds

required_data: airport/rail/bus/ferry schedules and status
why_not_fake: Operator capacity data drives metric
operational_decision: Add shuttles, ferry trips, bus lanes, arrival staggering
threshold_localization: Ferry/island thresholds stricter than urban roads

formula: waste + water + wastewater + air/beach quality pressure vs limits
required_data: environment sensors, utilities, monitoring stations
why_not_fake: Compares observed pressure to environmental limits
operational_decision: Limit visitor flows and protect fragile zones
threshold_localization: Coastal, island and heritage zones use stricter caps

formula: weighted multilingual sentiment over recent reviews/social/hotline text
required_data: reviews, social APIs, hotline logs, survey text
why_not_fake: NLP output must retain model/version/source coverage
operational_decision: Quality management and safe redistribution filters
threshold_localization: Language and market mix need localized models

required_data: reviews, social complaints, hotline, visitor surveys
why_not_fake: Normalized by visitor volume to avoid popularity bias
operational_decision: Trigger sanitation, queue, service or safety response
threshold_localization: Thresholds differ for festivals, airports, beaches, heritage sites

formula: share of negative texts mentioning crowding/waiting/overload
required_data: NLP topic classifier over reviews/social/hotline text
why_not_fake: Topic evidence links dissatisfaction to overcrowding
operational_decision: Validate whether congestion harms experience
threshold_localization: Heritage and beach destinations have distinct crowd vocabulary
